context: Enterprise SaaS for Bakery & Confectionery Management (Commercial MVP Foundation & Full Modules)
emotional_tone: Warm, professional, reliable, artisan-crafted warmth paired with high-precision enterprise control
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Calm) with Performance Pro precision

typography.rules: H1 text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none. Overlines uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-xs font-semibold.

visual_enhancers.texture: Warm stone and wheat grain accents, subtle grain overlays on headers

layouts.responsive: mobile-first approach with fluid containers max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
layouts.sidebar: collapsible high-density navigation for Admin, Cashier, and Staff roles

motion.transitions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and interactive elements
accessibility.aria_labels: MANDATORY on all icon buttons and interactive controls

image_urls.description: Master baker working with artisan bread in a traditional stone oven
Artisan bakery display shelf with fresh breads and pastries
Fresh flatbreads baking inside a rustic stone oven

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for robust automated testing.
Implement full role-based access control (Admin, Caixa, Funcionário) with JWT authentication.
Include all 14 core modules: Login/Register, Dashboard, Ingredients, Recipes, Production, Products, Stock, POS (PDV), Cashier (Caixa), Financial, Reports, Customers, Employees, and Settings.
Ensure API communication with Express + Prisma backend is fully wired with React Query and robust error handling using Sonner toasts.
Maintain strict adherence to Tailwind CSS spacing scales (p-6, p-8, gap-6) and avoid pure #000000 or unstyled defaults.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays without blur.
